# Avatar

> A round portrait at the touch-target size.

Part of the [Nate Mills Design System](../README.md). It is a CSS class API, not a JavaScript component, so its props are the classes and HTML attributes below. Link the stylesheets as [Getting started](../foundations/getting-started.md) shows, then add the classes. Every component: [Components](../COMPONENTS.md).

## When to use

- A person's portrait beside their name, such as the site header or a quote.

## When not to use

- A brand mark or a logo: show it as an image, not a portrait.
- An icon-only control: use an icon Button.

## Alternatives

- **[Button](button.md):** The avatar and the icon button are both circles. The avatar is a person; the icon button is a control.

## How to use

**Element:** `<span class="avatar">` holding one `<img>`.

- Put `.avatar` on a `<span>` holding one `<img>` with `alt`, `width` and `height`.
- If the portrait goes somewhere, wrap the span in a link; the link takes focus.

**Classes:** `.avatar`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alt` | attribute on the `<img>`, string | The person's name | None. Required. | What a screen reader says. |
| `width, height` | attributes on the `<img>` | The image's own pixel size | None. Required. | Reserve the space before the image arrives. |

## Variants

Available variants: none. `.avatar` has one look, a 44px circle, and takes no modifiers.

## States

No interactive states: an avatar is a person and never takes a click or focus. When it sits inside a link, the link owns the states.

## Invalid combinations

Options that must not be used together. Each names the props above.

| Combination | Level | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `.avatar` with an `<img>` that has no `alt` | MUST NOT | A screen reader gets nothing, or the file name. |
| `.avatar` with an `<img>` that has no `width` and `height` | MUST NOT | The page shifts when the image arrives. |
| `.avatar` holding a brand logo | SHOULD NOT | The circle crops a logo; an avatar is a person. |

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Enter, Space | Do nothing: an avatar takes no input. |
| Tab | Passes over it: an avatar is not focusable. Wrapped in a link, Tab stops on the link. |
| Enter | Does nothing on its own; follows the link when one wraps it. |
| G in a screen reader's browse mode (VoiceOver: VO + Command + G) | Moves to the next image and reads the `<img>` alt text, the person's name. |

Wrapped in a link, the link takes focus instead.

## Rules

| Level | Rule | Checked by |
|---|---|---|
| MUST | Give the `<img>` alt text naming the person. | [Automated: axe accessibility scan](../foundations/checks.md#axe-accessibility-scan) |
| MUST | Give the `<img>` `width` and `height`, so the page does not shift as it loads. | [Automated: Image-size checks](../foundations/checks.md#image-size-checks) |

Automated checks run on natemills.me before every publish; the scripts live in the private source repository.

## Example

```html
<span class="avatar"><img src="your-portrait.jpg" alt="Your name" width="44" height="44"></span>
```

## Classes

| Class | Kind | What it does | Tokens it reads |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.avatar` | base | round portrait | `--avatar-radius`, `--color-border`, `--color-surface-sunken`, `--touch-target-min` |

## Tokens

Every token the classes above read, as data from tokens.json: write `var(--name)`, never the raw value. A component token belongs to one component: change it to restyle that component and nothing else. A semantic token is a shared role; never change one for a single component. The three tiers: [Tokens](../foundations/tokens.md#three-tiers).

| Token | Tier | Value | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--avatar-radius` | Semantic | `999px`, from `--radius-full` | Identity shape: the header profile mark (.avatar / .profile-mark), the Kind words faces (.kw-face) and the hero widget's four theme marks. Full by default, which on a square box is the same circle those surfaces drew with 50% before. |
| `--color-border` | Semantic | `#e4e4e7`; dark `#27272a`, from `--neutral-300` | Default hairline border and divider colour, theme-aware. Decoration only: never the only edge of an input or control, which needs 3:1; use text-tertiary there. |
| `--color-surface-sunken` | Semantic | `#ececec`; dark `#141416`, from `--neutral-200` | Recessed wells, insets, thumbnails, chips. A step below the card surface: light grey in light; the darker near-black (#141416) in dark. |
| `--touch-target-min` | Semantic | `44px` | Minimum size of a tappable control such as a button or icon button (44px, WCAG 2.5.5). The AA floor for small carousel dots is touch-target-dot (24px). |
